data.title: 诱宵美九 · 高空按摩浴缸的紫晶水汽
data.description: 豪华高层公寓的空中全景观景浴池内，温热水流打着旋泛起绵密的薰衣草精油泡沫。美九靠在浴池边的大理石枕台上，湿漉的银紫发丝贴在发烫微红的锁骨处。落地窗外是万家灯火的繁华都市，歌姬闭起双目轻哼着柔美的旋律，随后缓缓睁开含水的美眸，向你递出盛满温情的邀请。
data.location: rooftop penthouse infinity jacuzzi overlooking city skyline
data.action: 落地窗外是万家灯火的繁华都市，歌姬闭起双目轻哼着柔美的旋律，随后缓缓睁开含水的美眸

data.promptProse: In a panoramic high-rise bathroom overlooking the illuminated night skyline, Miku leans back against the marble edge of the steaming jacuzzi surrounded by swirling lavender bubbles. Water beads across her flushed cheeks as she opens her eyes with an inviting smile.
data.animaCaption: Reclining nude against the marble rim of the penthouse jacuzzi beneath thick lavender bath foam, she looks toward the viewer with a warm seductive smile as night city lights glow beyond the glass.
data.nsfwProse: Unclothed beneath the dense bath foam and steaming water, her bare shoulders, wet collarbones, and upper cleavage catch the dim warm interior glow.
